objective: Embed Arena V2 offline practice into the existing BUKLOD Main app, reuse canonical combat and art, and version generated artwork into the native visual baseline without owner-side downloading.
productionBaselineEvidence: Only GitHub source and the existing DEV Arena V2 simulation inspected. No production APK, OTA or server artifact claimed verified.
chosenApproach: Use preinstalled React Native/SVG/Expo Image/audio/orientation, reuse Arena V2 pure simulation, add one Expo route and Kingdom entry, and commit image bytes through a SHA-addressed generated asset manifest. No Godot native module or separate app in this slice.
selectionRationale: Minimal native risk: current app already includes the rendering and audio modules. Reusing the existing deterministic engine avoids duplicate combat rules or wallet authority while preserving zero-cost tooling and a same-package Android experience.
alternativeApproaches: Independent Godot APK or duplicate login (rejected; violates unified app requirement)
Ship concept graphics as unversioned remote mockups (rejected; fails visual baseline requirement)
Immediately enable real ranked multiplayer, trade SQL or Diamond awards without server validation (rejected)
preserveBehaviors: Existing Kingdom Map and official 13-station routing preserved; only a new Arena launch door is added
BUKLOD auth/character IDs, Circle Rank, server inventory, BP, QMP and Diamonds remain authoritative and unchanged
Active gameplay uses existing premium Kingdom audio without crossing into Wall or Connect screen audio
Existing ad slot remains; no ad overlays or new monetization in active Arena combat
Production users and native build/runtime receive no changes from this unmerged DEV branch
acceptanceChecks: Expo navigation from Kingdom Map to the in-app Arena route without external installation
Landscaped Arena input actions use the shared offline engine; orientation restored on leaving
13 canon characters resolve to existing bundled art with new versioned image registry
Source tests and scope-lock checks pass before staging build
Real Android visual/latency/controls and full online PvP remain explicitly unverified
Battle camera and minimap bound to the same deterministic world coordinates; siege/build/loot and repair actions available from in-app tactics only when legal.
The 3 existing BUKLOD Realm scene PNGs are mirrored in DEV with actual bytes, verified SHA-256 and Metro static registration; owner manual Library downloads are not required.
Arena has source-owned 2.5D breathing/walking portrait motion fallback for 13 canonical identities; genuine rigged combat sprite art is a separately pending fidelity gate.
Arena reuses existing packaged CC0 premium Kingdom orchestration and local WAV SFX with per-screen music/effects toggles, bounded event cues, and focus-scoped release.
All 13 canonical portraits have source-owned animated WebP 12-frame 2.5D avatar badges, generated automatically by DEV CI and committed by SHA to app registry. Not full-body combat sprites.

Procedurally matte and composite each of the 13 canonical full-body source illustrations into four transparent eight-frame WebP states: idle, walk, attack and skill. Actual visual fidelity remains unverified.
